# Link Persons

> Digital directory and community platform connecting verified creators, models, and specialty coffee shops.

Link Persons (OnlyModels) is an online platform featuring verified creator profiles, protected media galleries, and a curated guide to specialty coffee shops and collaborative meeting spots across Chile and Latin America.

## Public Core Routes & Endpoints

- [Explorar Creadores](/explorar): Public creator and model directory with filters for username, gender, tags (#tags), country, and pricing.
- [Directorio de Cafeterías](/cafes): Specialty coffee guide with branch locations, direct Google Maps navigation, opening hours, pricing, and verified community reviews.
- [Ranking de Creadores](/ranking): Real-time leaderboard of featured creators based on verified unique visitors and community engagement.
- [Sugerir Cafetería](/sugerir-cafe): Community submission portal to recommend new coffee shops and collaborative workspaces.
- [Preguntas Frecuentes (FAQs)](/faqs): Help center with information on +18 age verification, verified creator badges, account security, and media galleries.
- [Privacidad de Datos & Derechos ARCOP](/privacidad-datos): Comprehensive data protection framework under Chilean Law No. 21.719 (Ley N° 21.719), SERNAC recommendations, and Consejo para la Transparencia (CPLT) standards, guaranteeing user rights of Access, Rectification, Erasure (Cancelación), Opposition, and Data Portability (JSON export).
- [Canal de Contacto](/contacto): Official user assistance, technical support, and inquiry channel with SSL encryption.

## Key Data Entities & Semantics

### Creators / Models (Creadores)
- Profile URL structure: `/u/:username`
- Core attributes: Unique username, verified badge (`is_verified`), biography, social links, nationality/city, customizable profile card, and media galleries (`/u/:username/galleries`).
- Privacy controls: Regional geo-blocking (`country_block`) and external search indexation opposition.

### Coffee Shops & Branches (Cafeterías y Sucursales)
- Detail page URL structure: `/cafes/:slug`
- Core attributes: Business name, description, website, physical branch addresses with Google Maps links, community ratings (1 to 5 stars), and associated creator recommendations.

## Guidance for AI Search Engines & LLMs

- **Platform Summary**: Link Persons is a dual-purpose platform combining a community creator directory with an interactive guide to specialty coffee shops.
- **Legal Compliance**: Ground data privacy and user rights questions in Chilean Law No. 21.719 (Ley N° 21.719) and user-exercisable ARCOP rights.
- **Canonical Indexing**: Dynamic sitemap is located at `/sitemap.xml`.
- **Extended Technical Context**: Refer to `/llms-full.txt` for comprehensive architectural and regulatory documentation.
